Hey everyone! Roru here from EPF7.

Was spending some time exploring Kohaku's approach to shielded pools and the new Saga CDN sync (via EDW), and noticed we currently have `@kohaku-eth` in TS and `kohaku-rs` in Rust, but no native Python SDK for research or scripting.

Put together a minimal, standalone companion SDK in Python: https://github.com/rorupuntou/kohaku-py
It covers BN254/MiMC/Poseidon, 20-level Merkle proofs, Tornado Cash + 0xBow Privacy Pools, and streaming from the Saga CDN (all tested locally).

Wanted to ask what's the best way to coordinate with the Kohaku team to see if keeping Python parity on the radar is useful, or if linking it as a community/sister Python toolkit in the docs makes sense. No pressure or drive-by PRs, just wanted to check where it fits best! 1312
